svg.title: Chatham XIII: Yellow Red
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and vivid screen colors. Chatham XIII identified by EK464 caption and unique yellow/red combination in the view. Internal proportions and overall aspect estimated from oblique installation photograph; normalized-only schematic pending frontal plate.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/exhibition/ellsworth-kelly-chatham-series/; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
